LanguageData.Gun_Springfield_M1903_RWP.label: Springfield M1903
LanguageData.Gun_Springfield_M1903_RWP.description: The Springfield M1903 is a bolt-action rifle renowned for its accuracy and reliability. Originally used during the early 20th century, it is excellent for long-range shooting, making it ideal for picking off enemies from a distance. Its powerful shots can penetrate armor effectively, though its firing rate is slower due to the bolt-action mechanism. Perfect for marksmen who value precision.
